desc: The Balikli BLK Bolt Action-Rifle family of rifles builds upon the 60-year-old legacy of the proven 700 design. An homage to an icon, the BLK carries forward a tradition of proven accuracy and versatility into a new era of quality and value. Classic bolt- action design and stunning old-world craftsmanship meet modern manufacturing processes to deliver a rifle that captures the features treasured by American hunters and sport shooters alike.
